about: The proof behind the X Article run-receipts-article, recorded 2026-10-11 against the production database and signed with the production receipt key. Each entry is the full signed envelope exactly as GET /api/runs?id= returns it, minus the server-side verification field, so anyone can re-verify it offline with: node scripts/run-receipt-verify.mjs <file or id> --signer Fcwqit9x1KmfUboPtoVWBUdEuonNyTA8T6xtfAEPpPeH. The first two receipts are the same prompt before and after the director fix of 2026-10-11.
